section_summary: This section contains Allied occupation directives and reports on Japanese whaling near the Bonin and Kazan Islands, in coastal waters, and in the Antarctic. It also contains the Final Act of the 1946 International Whaling Conference and most of its convention and schedule; the convention continues beyond page 160.

subfiles.title: Whaling Operations Around Bonin (Ogasawara) and Kazan Islands, SCAPIN 371
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers; H. W. Allen
subfiles.to: Imperial Japanese Government, through Central Liaison Office
subfiles.about: Authorizes specified Japanese whalers and carriers near the Bonin and Kazan Islands under strict limits.
subfiles.summary: Permits named vessels to whale in a defined area from December 1945 through March 1946, while prohibiting island landings, harbor use and contact.

subfiles.title: Duplicate of SCAPIN 371
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers; H. W. Allen
subfiles.to: Imperial Japanese Government, through Central Liaison Office
subfiles.about: Repeats the Bonin and Kazan whaling authorization and its vessel list.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy of the directive on permitted vessels, dates, route and restrictions.

subfiles.title: Substitution of carriers in Bonin and Kazan whaling operations, Serial 1086
subfiles.from: Administrator, Naval Shipping Control for Japanese Merchant Marine; R. A. Chamberlain
subfiles.about: Authorizes three Shinsei Maru carriers to replace two carriers in the whaling area.
subfiles.summary: Approves three carriers and orders Nos. 5 and 75 Shinsei Maru home.

subfiles.title: Duplicate of SCAJAP Serial 1086
subfiles.from: Administrator, Naval Shipping Control for Japanese Merchant Marine; R. A. Chamberlain
subfiles.about: Repeats the substitution of fish carriers for Bonin and Kazan whaling.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate authorization for replacement Shinsei Maru carriers.

subfiles.title: Extension of Bonin and Kazan whaling, SCAPIN 847
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers; B. M. Fitch
subfiles.about: Extends Japanese whaling near the islands through April 1946.
subfiles.summary: Sets the April operating area, names a factory ship and killer boats, and repeats the landing and harbor prohibitions.

subfiles.title: Duplicate of SCAPIN 847
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers; B. M. Fitch
subfiles.about: Repeats the April 1946 whaling extension.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate copy of the operating area, vessel list and restrictions.

subfiles.title: SCAP authorized fishing areas
subfiles.about: Maps successive limits on Japanese fishing areas.
subfiles.summary: Map with a legend showing authorized fishing boundaries.

subfiles.title: SCAP authorized fishing areas, duplicate
subfiles.about: Repeats the map of Japanese fishing limits.
subfiles.summary: Second copy of the authorized fishing area map.

subfiles.title: Area Authorized for Japanese Fishing and Whaling, SCAPIN 1033, partial copy
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.about: Defines expanded Japanese fishing and whaling boundaries.
subfiles.summary: First page of a copy setting geographic limits and restrictions near southern islands.

subfiles.title: Area Authorized for Japanese Fishing and Whaling, SCAPIN 1033
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers; John B. Cooley
subfiles.about: Sets occupation era fishing boundaries and restrictions around certain islands.
subfiles.summary: Rescinds earlier area rules, gives new coordinates, bars close approach to Takeshima and southern islands, and disclaims territorial implications.

subfiles.title: Reply to Washington Radio Regarding Japanese Antarctic Whaling Project
subfiles.about: Provides background on Antarctic expedition supervision and the status of whaling factory ships.
subfiles.summary: Explains the roles of two U.S. Army representatives and Japanese inspectors, lists supporting directives, and reports that conversion of a third tanker has been suspended.

subfiles.title: Reported Killing of Right Whale, Tokyo despatch 740
subfiles.from: George Atcheson Jr., United States Political Adviser for Japan
subfiles.about: Investigates a reported right whale catch near the Bonin Islands.
subfiles.summary: Finds no right whale in the 1945–46 Bonin records; a whale recorded as ‘other’ was a bottlenose caught near Akkeshi.

subfiles.title: Weekly Report on Japanese Whaling Activities, Tokyo despatch 742
subfiles.from: United States Political Adviser for Japan
subfiles.about: Forwards coastal whaling and Antarctic fleet reports for 3–9 November 1946.
subfiles.summary: Cover despatch listing three enclosed weekly reports.

subfiles.title: Weekly Report of Whaling Activities in Japanese Coastal Waters, 3–9 November 1946
subfiles.about: Lists coastal stations, catchers and vessels out of service.
subfiles.summary: Reports 45 whales and notes vessel repairs, construction and a fire aboard Kyo Maru No. 5.

subfiles.title: Whale Products Derived from Japanese Coastal Whaling Activities, 3–9 November 1946
subfiles.about: Tabulates products from 45 whales caught by three companies.
subfiles.summary: Records oil, meat and blubber output by company.

subfiles.title: Weekly Status Report of the 1946–47 Japanese Antarctic Whaling Fleet, 3–9 November 1946
subfiles.about: Tracks readiness, location and work on Antarctic whaling vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists Nippon Suisan and Taiyo Gyogyo factory ships, catchers and carriers, with completion estimates and movements. It also notes a catcher sinking on 6 November.

subfiles.title: Estimated arrival of Nissin Maru at Lombok Strait, Tokyo telegram 539
subfiles.about: Gives the whaling ship Nissin Maru’s estimated arrival at Lombok Strait.
subfiles.summary: Estimates arrival at 0001 GMT on 6 December.

subfiles.title: Delayed copy of Tokyo telegram 539
subfiles.about: Repeats the Nissin Maru arrival estimate.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate telegram marked as delayed in transmission.

subfiles.title: Letter of Appreciation for Max W. Bishop, Tokyo despatch 730
subfiles.about: Forwards a SCAP letter praising Max W. Bishop’s Antarctic expedition work.
subfiles.summary: Cover despatch enclosing the appreciation letter.

subfiles.title: Letter of Appreciation
subfiles.from: Hubert G. Schenck, Natural Resources Section
subfiles.about: Commends Max W. Bishop’s work organizing the Antarctic whaling expedition.
subfiles.summary: Credits Bishop’s administrative help with the expedition’s preparation.

subfiles.title: Routing note for despatch 730
subfiles.about: Requests a hectograph copy for the dossier.
subfiles.summary: Directs filing of a copy of despatch 730.

subfiles.title: Weekly Report on Japanese Whaling Activities, Tokyo despatch 751
subfiles.from: United States Political Adviser for Japan
subfiles.about: Forwards reports for 10–16 November 1946.
subfiles.summary: Cover despatch listing coastal catch, product and Antarctic fleet reports.

subfiles.title: Whale Products Derived from Japanese Coastal Whaling Activities, 10–16 November 1946
subfiles.about: Tabulates coastal whale products for the following week.
subfiles.summary: Lists products by company; OCR obscures several figures.

subfiles.title: International Whaling Conference results
subfiles.about: Summarizes the conference outcome and forwards its final documents.
subfiles.summary: Notes new regulations and a whaling commission; Japanese whaling was not discussed.

subfiles.title: International Whaling Conference: The Final Documents
subfiles.about: Identifies the Final Act, Convention and Protocol.
subfiles.summary: Title and contents page for the conference documents.

subfiles.title: Final Act of the International Whaling Conference
subfiles.doc_type: final act with annex and addendum
subfiles.about: Records delegates, conference committees, resolutions and whale nomenclature.
subfiles.summary: The Final Act names national delegations and committees and records recommendations on conservation, seasons, catches, penalties and scientific data. Its annex compares whale names across languages; an addendum records a defeated Dutch proposal.

subfiles.title: International Convention for the Regulation of Whaling
subfiles.about: Establishes international rules for whaling and an International Whaling Commission.
subfiles.summary: The convention establishes the Commission, its amendment process, research and reporting duties, enforcement, ratification and withdrawal rules. Its schedule sets inspection, species, season, area, catch, size, processing and reporting requirements. The schedule continues after page 160.
